context:
Goal: a guard refuses a subagent's message to a finished reviewer, so no work is lost to a reviewer that is already gone.
Problem (rule): no record says which transcript a subagent's PreToolUse `transcript_path` names, so the guard cannot be built without guessing. A settings write needs words you type in the acting session's chat, and the auto-mode classifier refused the lane's probe ("[Self-Modification]").
Based on (read): the hooks docs describe the split only for SubagentStop, and no log on any machine records a subagent PreToolUse payload (coordinator, 06:01 CST Nov 8).
Based on (measured): the classifier refused the probe's write to /root/.claude/settings.json in the lane's own throwaway cloud container. Nothing was written. The refusal came by 06:00 CST Nov 8 (coordinator, 06:04 CST).
Based on (ruling): item 222 a (owner, Nov 3) granted a one-shot hook-allow probe for grant-reaches-lanes, in the same shape.
Departs from: main, which has no record of a subagent's PreToolUse payload — adds a one-shot probe: a temporary PreToolUse hook logs one subagent payload and one Workflow agent payload, and then the hook is removed.
Meanwhile: both resume-guard steps wait. #1917 goes on without them.

options.gain: A real measure, and the guard gets built on it. No change on your computer.
options.how: In lane resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree's cloud container (session_013NEJL3qSsV2LJ6R1a1HMCB), the lane adds the hook, spawns one subagent and one Workflow agent, logs both payloads, then removes the hook. You type the grant in that lane's chat.
options.label: Grant the probe in the lane's throwaway cloud container
options.lose: One approval prompt for a settings write in a container that is thrown away, and a line you type in that lane's chat.

options.gain: A real measure, on the machine where most lanes run.
options.how: A session on your computer adds the hook, spawns the two agents, logs both payloads, then removes the hook.
options.label: Run the same probe in a session on your computer
options.lose: A settings change on your machine, which needs your grant and your session.

options.how: Steps resume-guard-subagent-sends and resume-guard-workflow-agents are parked until 2026-11-21. Their notes already say a subagent's message to a finished reviewer is unchecked.
options.label: Park both resume-guard steps
options.lose: A subagent's message to a finished reviewer stays unchecked, so work sent to a gone reviewer can still be lost.

short: One-shot probe of a subagent's hook payload
title: May a lane's throwaway cloud container add a temporary hook to log one subagent's tool-call payload, then remove it?
